# Civ VI Full-Anthology Reference — Vol 3: Districts, Buildings & Wonders

<!-- generated by Stage 2 reference build, 2026-08-03 -->
> **Game configuration this volume describes:** RULESET_EXPANSION_2 (Gathering
> Storm ruleset, which includes all Rise & Fall content) + every official DLC
> pack. Optional game modes (Heroes, Secret Societies, Monopolies, Barbarian
> Clans, Apocalypse, Zombies, etc.) are **not** included — the live capture
> calibration shows they are off in this game. Scenario-only content excluded.
>
> **Sourcing:** every value is machine-extracted from the game's own data files
> (base + Expansion1 + Expansion2 XML and each DLC pack's Data XML, merged in
> the game's modinfo-declared load order). Nothing comes from model memory.
> Verified against the live game DB: 36 districts (26 specialty), 54 resources
> (34 luxuries), 7 victories, 8 governors / 48 promotions — all exact matches.
>
> **Trust order if something disagrees:** 1) the live snapshot from the
> tracker, 2) this document, 3) anything else. Mods (e.g. Real Strategy) can
> shift values; the live snapshot always wins.

## Districts — all 36 (26 specialty)

Cost scaling: district base cost inflates with tech/civic tree progress (CostProgressionModel per district, shown where set). Unique civ districts cost half the standard equivalent. 'Specialty' = counts against the population-based district limit (RequiresPopulation).

### Acropolis (unique; replaces Theater Square)
- **Stats:** base cost 27; maintenance 1; specialty; appeal 1; +2 city strength; unlocked by civic Drama and Poetry
- **Effect:** A district unique to Greece for cultural sites. Replaces the Theater Square district and cheaper to build. Awards 1 Envoy when completed. +1 Culture bonus for adjacent City Center. +1 Culture bonus for each adjacent wonder and district. Can only be built on Hills.
- **Adjacency:** +1 Culture per adjacent wonder | +1 Culture per adjacent district | +1 Culture per adjacent City Center | +1 Culture per adjacent Government Plaza | +2 Culture per adjacent Entertainment Complex | +2 Culture per adjacent Water Park | +2 Culture per adjacent Pamukkale

### Aerodrome
- **Stats:** base cost 54; maintenance 1; specialty; appeal -1; air slots 4; +2 city strength; unlocked by tech Flight
- **Effect:** A district that allows you to build and store aircraft. Cannot be built on Hills.

### Aqueduct
- **Stats:** base cost 36; non-specialty; aqueduct-class; unlocked by tech Engineering
- **Effect:** A district that provides this city with a source of fresh water from an adjacent River, Lake, Oasis, or Mountain. Cities that do not yet have existing fresh water receive up to 6 Housing. Cities that already have existing fresh water will instead get +2 Housing. If built adjacent to a Geothermal Fissure +1 Amenity. Prevents Food loss during Drought. Must be built adjacent to the City Center. Military Engineers can spend a charge to complete 20% of an Aqueduct's production.

### Bath (unique; replaces Aqueduct)
- **Stats:** base cost 18; non-specialty; housing +2; amenities +1; aqueduct-class; unlocked by tech Engineering
- **Effect:** A district unique to Rome for city growth. Replaces the Aqueduct district and cheaper to build. It provides this city with a source of fresh water from an adjacent River, Lake, Oasis, or Mountain. Cities that do not yet have existing fresh water receive up to 6 Housing. Cities that already have existing fresh water will instead get +2 Housing. If built adjacent to a Geothermal Fissure +1 Amenity. In all cases the Bath provides an additional bonus of +2 Housing and +1 Amenity. Prevents Food loss during Drought. Must be built adjacent to the City Center. Military Engineers can spend a charge to complete 20% of a Bath's production.

### Campus
- **Stats:** base cost 54; maintenance 1; specialty; +2 city strength; unlocked by tech Writing
- **Effect:** A district in your city for scientific endeavors.
- **Adjacency:** +1 Science per adjacent Grassland (Mountain) | +1 Science per adjacent Plains (Mountain) | +1 Science per adjacent Desert (Mountain) | +1 Science per adjacent Tundra (Mountain) | +1 Science per adjacent Snow (Mountain) | +1 Science per 2 adjacent Rainforest | +1 Science per 2 adjacent district | +2 Science per adjacent Great Barrier Reef | +1 Science per adjacent Government Plaza | +2 Science per adjacent Geothermal Fissure | +2 Science per adjacent Reef | +2 Science per adjacent Pamukkale

### Canal
- **Stats:** base cost 81; non-specialty; appeal 1; unlocked by tech Steam Power
- **Effect:** A district built on flat land to connect two bodies of water or a body of water to a City Center. Trade Routes traveling through it can multiply the Gold they get from districts at their destination. Canals may either go straight through the hex or bend by 60 degrees. However three-way Canal junctures are not allowed and Canals must have a full land tile on each side of the waterway they create. Military Engineers can spend a charge to complete 20% of a Canal's production.

### City Center
- **Stats:** base cost 54; non-specialty; air slots 1
- **Effect:** This is the City Center.

### Commercial Hub
- **Stats:** base cost 54; specialty; +2 city strength; unlocked by tech Currency
- **Effect:** A district in your city specializing in finance and trade. +1 Trade Route capacity, if this city does not yet have a Harbor district.
- **Adjacency:** +2 Gold per adjacent river | +2 Gold per adjacent Harbor | +2 Gold per adjacent Royal Navy Dockyard | +1 Gold per 2 adjacent district | +1 Gold per adjacent Government Plaza | +2 Gold per adjacent Pamukkale | +2 Gold per adjacent Cothon

### Copacabana (unique; replaces Water Park)
- **Stats:** base cost 27; maintenance 1; specialty; amenities +2; appeal 1; +2 city strength; must be on coast; unlocked by civic Natural History
- **Effect:** A district unique to Brazil. Replaces the Water Park district, and provides +2 Amenities. Also unlocks the Carnival project, which grants an additional +1 Amenity when underway and a variety of Great People points once completed. Cannot be built in a city with a Street Carnival. Cannot be built on Reef.

### Cothon (unique; replaces Harbor)
- **Stats:** base cost 27; specialty; +2 city strength; must be on coast; unlocked by tech Celestial Navigation
- **Effect:** A district unique to Phoenicia for naval activity in your city. Replaces the Harbor district and cheaper to build. Must be built on Coast or Lake Terrain adjacent to land. +50% Production towards naval units and Settlers in this city. All wounded naval units in this city’s borders heal +100 HP each turn.
- **Adjacency:** +1 Gold per adjacent sea resource | +1 Gold per 2 adjacent district | +2 Gold per adjacent City Center | +1 Gold per adjacent Government Plaza

### Dam
- **Stats:** base cost 81; non-specialty; housing +3; amenities +1; appeal 1; unlocked by tech Buttress
- **Effect:** A district built on a Floodplains tile to improve the comfort of living along this river. Prevents damage from flooding of this river (though yields from flooding drop by 50%). Prevents Food loss during Drought. Only one may be built along each river's floodplain (whichever player completes one first) and the river must traverse at least two sides of the Dam hex. Military Engineers can spend a charge to complete 20% of a Dam's production.

### Diplomatic Quarter
- **Stats:** base cost 30; maintenance 1; specialty; +2 city strength; unlocked by tech Mathematics
- **Effect:** Your civilization receives +1 Culture for each Delegation or Embassy from a foreign civilization through diplomacy. +1 Envoy if built next to the city center. Enemy Spies operate at 2 levels below normal targeting this district and adjacent districts. Only 1 can exist in your empire at a time.

### Encampment
- **Stats:** base cost 54; maintenance 1; specialty; appeal -1; +2 city strength; cannot be adjacent to city center; unlocked by tech Bronze Working
- **Effect:** A district in your city for military facilities.

### Entertainment Complex
- **Stats:** base cost 54; maintenance 1; specialty; amenities +1; appeal 1; +2 city strength; unlocked by civic Games and Recreation
- **Effect:** A district in your city dedicated to keeping your people happy by increasing Amenities. Cannot be built in a city with a Water Park.

### Government Plaza
- **Stats:** base cost 30; maintenance 1; specialty; +2 city strength; unlocked by civic State Workforce
- **Effect:** A district placed once in your empire to commemorate your government choices. Provides +8 Loyalty per turn to this city, and an increase of +1 to the adjacency bonuses being earned by any adjacent district. Awards +1 Governor Title.

### Hansa (unique; replaces Industrial Zone)
- **Stats:** base cost 27; maintenance 1; specialty; appeal -1; +2 city strength; unlocked by tech Apprenticeship
- **Effect:** A district unique to Germany for industrial activity. Replaces the Industrial Zone district and cheaper to build. + 2Production bonus for each adjacent Commercial Hub, Aqueduct, Canal, and Dam districts. +1 Production bonus for each adjacent resource. +1 Production bonus for every two adjacent district tiles.
- **Adjacency:** +2 Production per adjacent Commercial Hub | +1 Production per 2 adjacent district | +1 Production per adjacent true | +1 Production per adjacent Government Plaza | +2 Production per adjacent Aqueduct | +2 Production per adjacent Canal | +2 Production per adjacent Dam

### Harbor
- **Stats:** base cost 54; specialty; +2 city strength; must be on coast; unlocked by tech Celestial Navigation
- **Effect:** A district for naval activity in your city. Also removes the Movement penalty for embarking and disembarking to and from this tile. Must be built on Coast or Lake Terrain adjacent to land. +1 Trade Route capacity, if this city does not yet have a Commercial Hub district.
- **Adjacency:** +1 Gold per adjacent sea resource | +1 Gold per 2 adjacent district | +2 Gold per adjacent City Center | +1 Gold per adjacent Government Plaza

### Hippodrome (unique; replaces Entertainment Complex)
- **Stats:** base cost 27; maintenance 1; specialty; amenities +3; appeal 1; +2 city strength; unlocked by civic Games and Recreation
- **Effect:** A district unique to Byzantium. Replaces the Entertainment Complex district, provides +3 Amenities, and is cheaper to build. When the Hippodrome and buildings in this district are constructed, receive a Heavy Cavalry unit. Units granted from this district do not have a resource maintenance cost. Cannot be built in a city with a Water Park.

### Holy Site
- **Stats:** base cost 54; maintenance 1; specialty; appeal 1; +2 city strength; unlocked by tech Astrology
- **Effect:** A district in your city for religious worship.
- **Adjacency:** +2 Faith per adjacent true | +1 Faith per adjacent Grassland (Mountain) | +1 Faith per adjacent Plains (Mountain) | +1 Faith per adjacent Desert (Mountain) | +1 Faith per adjacent Tundra (Mountain) | +1 Faith per adjacent Snow (Mountain) | +1 Faith per 2 adjacent Woods | +1 Faith per 2 adjacent district | +1 Faith per adjacent Government Plaza | +1 Faith per adjacent Pamukkale

### Ikanda (unique; replaces Encampment)
- **Stats:** base cost 27; maintenance 1; specialty; housing +1; appeal -1; +2 city strength; cannot be adjacent to city center; unlocked by tech Bronze Working
- **Effect:** A district unique to Zulu which replaces the Encampment. Provides +1 Housing. Once the Civic or Technology prerequisite is met, Corps and Armies can be built outright. Buildings in the Ikanda receive +2 Gold and +1 Science. Faster Corps and Army creation.

### Industrial Zone
- **Stats:** base cost 54; maintenance 1; specialty; appeal -1; +2 city strength; unlocked by tech Apprenticeship
- **Effect:** A district in your city for industrial activity.
- **Adjacency:** +1 Production per adjacent Quarry | +1 Production per 2 adjacent district | +1 Production per adjacent Government Plaza | +1 Production per 2 adjacent Mine | +1 Production per 2 adjacent Lumber Mill | +2 Production per adjacent Aqueduct | +2 Production per adjacent Bath | +2 Production per adjacent Canal | +2 Production per adjacent Dam | +1 Production per adjacent strategic resource

### Lavra (unique; replaces Holy Site)
- **Stats:** base cost 27; maintenance 1; specialty; appeal 1; +2 city strength; unlocked by tech Astrology
- **Effect:** A district unique to Russia for religious activity. Replaces the Holy Site district and cheaper to build. Your city border grows by one tile each time a Great Person is expended in this city. The Lavra provides +1 Great Writer point per turn with a Shrine, +1 Great Artist point per turn with a Temple, and +1 Great Musician point per turn with a Worship building.
- **Adjacency:** +2 Faith per adjacent true | +1 Faith per adjacent Grassland (Mountain) | +1 Faith per adjacent Plains (Mountain) | +1 Faith per adjacent Desert (Mountain) | +1 Faith per adjacent Tundra (Mountain) | +1 Faith per adjacent Snow (Mountain) | +1 Faith per 2 adjacent Woods | +1 Faith per 2 adjacent district | +1 Faith per adjacent Government Plaza | +1 Faith per adjacent Pamukkale

### Mbanza (unique; replaces Neighborhood)
- **Stats:** base cost 27; non-specialty; housing +5; +2 city strength; unlocked by civic Guilds
- **Effect:** A district unique to Kongo that can only be constructed in Rainforest or Woods. Replaces the Neighborhood district but is available earlier and cheaper to build. Provides +5 Housing , +2 Food, and +4 Gold, regardless of Appeal.

### Neighborhood
- **Stats:** base cost 54; non-specialty; housing +4; +2 city strength; unlocked by civic Urbanization
- **Effect:** A district in your city that provides housing based on the Appeal of the tile: Breathtaking: +6 Housing. Charming: +5 Housing. Average: +4 Housing. Uninviting: +3 Housing. Disgusting: +2 Housing.

### Observatory (unique; replaces Campus)
- **Stats:** base cost 27; maintenance 1; specialty; +2 city strength; unlocked by tech Writing
- **Effect:** A district unique to the Maya for scientific endeavors. Replaces the Campus district and cheaper to build. +2 Science bonus for adjacent Plantations. +1 Science bonus for every two adjacent Farm or district tiles.
- **Adjacency:** +1 Science per 2 adjacent district | +2 Science per adjacent Plantation | +1 Science per 2 adjacent Farm | +2 Science per adjacent Great Barrier Reef | +1 Science per adjacent Government Plaza | +2 Science per adjacent Pamukkale

### Oppidum (unique; replaces Industrial Zone)
- **Stats:** base cost 27; maintenance 1; specialty; appeal -1; +2 city strength; unlocked by tech Iron Working
- **Effect:** A district unique to Gaul that is cheaper and available earlier than the district it replaces, the Industrial Zone. The Oppidum district is defensible with a ranged attack. When the first Oppidum is constructed the Apprenticeship technology is unlocked. +2 Production adjacency bonus from Quarries and strategic resources.
- **Adjacency:** +2 Production per adjacent Quarry | +2 Production per adjacent strategic resource | +1 Production per adjacent Government Plaza

### Preserve
- **Stats:** base cost 54; specialty; housing +1; appeal 1; cannot be adjacent to city center; unlocked by civic Mysticism
- **Effect:** Grants up to 3 Housing based on Appeal. Culture bombs adjacent neutral tiles, and increases their Appeal by 1.

### Royal Navy Dockyard (unique; replaces Harbor)
- **Stats:** base cost 27; specialty; +2 city strength; must be on coast; unlocked by tech Celestial Navigation
- **Effect:** A district unique to England for naval activity in your city. Replaces the Harbor district and cheaper to build. Also removes the Movement penalty for embarking and disembarking to and from this tile. Must be built on Coast or Lake Terrain adjacent to land. +1 Movement for all naval units built in Dockyard +2 Gold when built on a foreign continent +1 Trade Route capacity.
- **Adjacency:** +1 Gold per adjacent sea resource | +1 Gold per 2 adjacent district | +2 Gold per adjacent City Center | +1 Gold per adjacent Government Plaza

### Seowon (unique; replaces Campus)
- **Stats:** base cost 27; maintenance 1; specialty; +2 city strength; unlocked by tech Writing
- **Effect:** A district unique to Korea for scientific endeavors. Replaces the Campus district. +4 Science. -1 Science for every adjacent district tile. Must be built on Hills.
- **Adjacency:** +4 Science per adjacent itself | +-1 Science per adjacent district | +1 Science per adjacent Government Plaza

### Spaceport
- **Stats:** base cost 1800; non-specialty; appeal -1; +2 city strength; unlocked by tech Rocketry
- **Effect:** A district that is required to construct the Science Victory projects. This includes Launch Earth Satellite, Launch Moon Landing, Launch Mars Colony, and Launch Exoplanet Expedition. Cannot be built on Hills.

### Street Carnival (unique; replaces Entertainment Complex)
- **Stats:** base cost 27; maintenance 1; specialty; amenities +2; appeal 1; +2 city strength; unlocked by civic Games and Recreation
- **Effect:** A district unique to Brazil. Replaces the Entertainment Complex district, and provides +2 Amenities. Also unlocks the Carnival project, which grants an additional +1 Amenity when underway and a variety of Great People points once completed. Cannot be built in a city with a Copacabana.

### Suguba (unique; replaces Commercial Hub)
- **Stats:** base cost 27; specialty; +2 city strength; unlocked by tech Currency
- **Effect:** A district unique to Mali specializing in finance and trade that replaces the Commercial Hub. Units, Buildings, and Districts are 20% cheaper to purchase with Gold and Faith in this City. +2 Gold bonus for each adjacent Holy Site. +2 Gold bonus from a tile containing a River edge. +1 Gold bonus for every two adjacent district tiles.
- **Adjacency:** +2 Gold per adjacent Pamukkale | +2 Gold per adjacent river | +2 Gold per adjacent Holy Site | +2 Gold per adjacent Lavra | +1 Gold per 2 adjacent district | +1 Gold per adjacent Government Plaza

### Theater Square
- **Stats:** base cost 54; maintenance 1; specialty; appeal 1; +2 city strength; unlocked by civic Drama and Poetry
- **Effect:** A district in your city for cultural sites.
- **Adjacency:** +1 Culture per adjacent wonder | +1 Culture per 2 adjacent district | +1 Culture per adjacent Government Plaza | +2 Culture per adjacent Entertainment Complex | +2 Culture per adjacent Water Park | +2 Culture per adjacent Street Carnival | +2 Culture per adjacent Copacabana | +2 Culture per adjacent Pamukkale | +2 Culture per adjacent Hippodrome

### Thành (unique; replaces Encampment)
- **Stats:** base cost 27; maintenance 1; non-specialty; appeal -1; +2 city strength; cannot be adjacent to city center; unlocked by tech Bronze Working
- **Effect:** A district unique to Vietnam which replaces the Encampment. +2 Culture for each adjacent district. After Flight is researched receive Tourism equal to the Culture output. This district does not require population, is cheaper to build, cannot be built adjacent to the city center, does not provide Great People points, and is not a specialty district.
- **Adjacency:** +2 Culture per adjacent district

### Water Park
- **Stats:** base cost 54; maintenance 1; specialty; amenities +1; appeal 1; +2 city strength; must be on coast; unlocked by civic Natural History
- **Effect:** A district placed out on a coastal tile dedicated to keeping your people happy by increasing Amenities. Cannot be built in a city with an Entertainment Complex. Cannot be built on Reef.

### Wonder
- **Stats:** base cost 0; non-specialty; appeal 1


## Buildings (non-wonder)

### Airport
- **Stats:** cost 600; maintenance 2; in Aerodrome; unlocked by tech Advanced Flight, district Aerodrome; requires 1 power; requires building Hangar
- **Yields:** +3 Production; +2 Production if powered
- **Effect:** +50% combat experience for air units trained in this city. +1 air unit slot in Aerodrome district. Allows the ability to airlift land units between Aerodrome districts with Airports after the Rapid Deployment civic is unlocked.

### Hangar
- **Stats:** cost 465; maintenance 1; in Aerodrome; unlocked by tech Flight, district Aerodrome
- **Yields:** +2 Production
- **Effect:** +25% combat experience for air units trained in this city. +1 air unit slot in Aerodrome district.

### Library
- **Stats:** cost 90; maintenance 1; in Campus; unlocked by tech Writing, district Campus; citizen slots 1
- **Yields:** +2 Science; +1 Scientist GPP

### Madrasa (unique; replaces University)
- **Stats:** cost 250; maintenance 2; in Campus; unlocked by civic Theology, district Campus; housing +1; citizen slots 1; requires building Library
- **Yields:** +5 Science; +1 Scientist GPP
- **Effect:** A building unique to Arabia. Bonus Faith equal to the adjacency bonus of the Campus district.

### Navigation School (unique; replaces University)
- **Stats:** cost 250; maintenance 2; in Campus; unlocked by tech Education, district Campus; housing +1; citizen slots 1; requires building Library
- **Yields:** +4 Science; +1 Admiral GPP; +1 Scientist GPP
- **Effect:** A building unique to Portugal. +25% Production towards naval units in this city. +1 Science for every two coast or lake tiles in this city. +1 Great Admiral and +1 Great Scientist point per turn.

### Research Lab
- **Stats:** cost 580; maintenance 3; in Campus; unlocked by tech Chemistry, district Campus; citizen slots 1; requires 3 power; requires building University
- **Yields:** +5 Science; +1 Scientist GPP; +1 Science per citizen worked; +5 Science if powered

### University
- **Stats:** cost 250; maintenance 2; in Campus; unlocked by tech Education, district Campus; housing +1; citizen slots 1; requires building Library
- **Yields:** +4 Science; +1 Scientist GPP

### Ancient Walls
- **Stats:** cost 80; maintenance 0; in City Center; unlocked by tech Masonry, district City Center
- **Effect:** Provides Walls around the City Center and Encampment district. Walls allow Ranged Strikes from the City Center and Encampment district, and must be defeated before a city can be assaulted. Provides 1 Tourism after advancing to the Conservation Civic.

### Flood Barrier
- **Stats:** cost 80; maintenance 1; in City Center; unlocked by tech Computers, district City Center
- **Effect:** Protects Coastal Lowland tiles in this city from flooding. Initial build cost and per turn maintenance are variable based on the number of Coastal Lowlands in this city and the current sea level. If constructed after some of a city's tiles have been flooded, those tiles can be repaired in full. Submerged tiles however are never recoverable. Must be built in a city with one or more Coastal Lowland tiles. Will not be pillaged if the city is captured.

### Granary
- **Stats:** cost 65; maintenance 0; in City Center; unlocked by tech Pottery, district City Center; housing +2
- **Yields:** +1 Food

### Medieval Walls
- **Stats:** cost 225; maintenance 0; in City Center; unlocked by tech Castles, district City Center; requires building Ancient Walls
- **Effect:** Increases the strength of your outer defenses. Provides 2 Tourism after advancing to the Conservation Civic.

### Monument
- **Stats:** cost 60; maintenance 0; in City Center; unlocked by district City Center
- **Yields:** +2 Culture

### Palace
- **Stats:** cost 1; maintenance 0; in City Center; unlocked by district City Center; housing +1; amenities +1
- **Yields:** +1 Culture; +5 Gold; +2 Production; +2 Science; 1 Great Work slot(s) [Palace]

### Palgum (unique; replaces Water Mill)
- **Stats:** cost 80; maintenance 0; in City Center; unlocked by tech Irrigation, district City Center; housing +1
- **Yields:** +2 Production
- **Effect:** A building unique to Babylon. +1 Housing and +2 Production. Freshwater tiles receive +1 Food. City must be adjacent to a River.

### Renaissance Walls
- **Stats:** cost 305; maintenance 0; in City Center; unlocked by tech Siege Tactics, district City Center; requires building Medieval Walls
- **Effect:** Raises the strength of your outer defenses to the highest possible level. Provides 3 Tourism after advancing to the Conservation Civic.

### Sewer
- **Stats:** cost 200; maintenance 2; in City Center; unlocked by tech Sanitation, district City Center; housing +2

- **Yields:** +4 Faith

- **Yields:** +2 Production
- **Effect:** A building unique to Hungary. +2 Amenities and +2 Production extends to each city center within 6 tiles. - **Yields:** +2 Faith; +1 Culture; +1 General GPP

- **Stats:** cost 445; maintenance 2; in Entertainment Complex; unlocked by civic Natural History, district Entertainment Complex; amenities +1; requires building Arena
- **Effect:** Bonus extends to each city center within 6 tiles. This bonus applies once to a city, and multiple copies of this building within 6 tiles of a city center do not provide additional bonuses.

### Ancestral Hall
- **Stats:** cost 150; maintenance 1; in Government Plaza; unlocked by district Government Plaza
- **Effect:** 50% increased Production toward Settlers in this City. New cities receive a free Builder. Awards +1 Governor Title.

### Audience Chamber
- **Stats:** cost 150; maintenance 1; in Government Plaza; unlocked by district Government Plaza
- **Effect:** +2 Amenities and +4 Housing in Cities with Governors -2 Loyalty in Cities without Governors. Awards +1 Governor Title.

- **Stats:** cost 400; unlocked by civic Military Training; placed on: Grassland / Plains / Tundra / Snow / Desert; must be adjacent to Encampment
- **Yields:** +3 Gold
- **Effect:** Grants 3 Archers, 3 Spearmen, and a Battering Ram. +50% Production towards anti-cavalry units. Must be built on flat land adjacent to an Encampment district with a Barracks.

### Stonehenge
- **Stats:** cost 180; unlocked by tech Astrology; placed on: Grassland / Plains / Tundra / Snow / Desert; adjacent resource Stone
- **Yields:** +2 Faith
- **Effect:** Grants a free Great Prophet. Great Prophets may found a Religion on Stonehenge instead of a Holy Site. Must be adjacent to Stone and on flat land.

### Sydney Opera House
- **Stats:** cost 1850; unlocked by civic Cultural Heritage; placed on: Coast and Lake; must be adjacent to Harbor; coastal, adjacent to land
- **Yields:** +8 Culture; +5 Musician GPP; 3 Great Work slot(s) [Music]
- **Effect:** Must be built on the Coast, adjacent to land and a Harbor district.

### Taj Mahal
- **Stats:** cost 920; unlocked by civic Humanism; requires river
- **Effect:** +1 Era Score from Historic Moment earned after this wonder is complete if that Moment is usually worth 2 or more Era Score. Must be built next to a River.

### Temple of Artemis
- **Stats:** cost 180; unlocked by tech Archery
- **Yields:** +4 Food
- **Effect:** Each Camp, Pasture, and Plantation improvement within 4 tiles of this wonder provides +1 Amenity. Must be placed adjacent to a Camp improvement.

### Terracotta Army
- **Stats:** cost 400; unlocked by tech Construction; placed on: Grassland / Plains; must be adjacent to Encampment
- **Yields:** +1 General GPP
- **Effect:** All current units gain a promotion level. All Archaeologists from the owner may enter foreign lands without Open Borders. Must be built on flat Grassland or Plains adjacent to an Encampment district with a Barracks or Stable.

### Torre de Belém
- **Stats:** cost 920; unlocked by civic Mercantilism; placed on: Coast and Lake; must be adjacent to Harbor; coastal, adjacent to land
- **Yields:** +5 Gold; +1 Admiral GPP
- **Effect:** International Trade Routes from this city receive +2 Gold for every Luxury Resource at the destination. When the Torre de Belém is constructed, cities not on your home continent receive the lowest Production cost city center building they can currently construct. Must be built on a Coast tile that is adjacent to a Harbor district.

### University of Sankore
- **Stats:** cost 710; unlocked by tech Education; placed on: Desert / Desert (Hills); must be adjacent to Campus
- **Yields:** +3 Science; +1 Faith; +2 Scientist GPP
- **Effect:** Other Civilizations' Trade Routes to this city provide +1 Science and +1 Gold for them. +2 Science for every Trade Route to this city. Domestic Trade Routes give an additional +1 Faith to this city. Must be built on the Desert or Desert Hills, and adjacent to a Campus district with a University.

### Venetian Arsenal
- **Stats:** cost 920; unlocked by tech Mass Production; placed on: Coast and Lake; must be adjacent to Industrial Zone; coastal, adjacent to land
- **Yields:** +2 Engineer GPP
- **Effect:** Receive a second naval unit each time you train a naval unit. Must be built on a Coast tile that is adjacent to an Industrial Zone district.
